name: bot-zap-supremo
description: Bot pessoal WhatsApp Termux-first com recuperação resiliente de conexão, View Once, arquivo local, monitoramento de eventos, cofre, mídia, Sticker Engine 2.0 e automações.

scripts.integration-test: rm -rf .test-runtime; BOT_ROOT=$PWD/.test-runtime node --loader ./tests/mock-loader.mjs ./tests/integration.mjs; code=$?; rm -rf .test-runtime; exit $code
scripts.connection-test: rm -rf .test-runtime; BOT_ROOT=$PWD/.test-runtime node --no-warnings --loader ./tests/sim-loader.mjs ./tests/connection-sim.mjs; code=$?; rm -rf .test-runtime; exit $code
